summary: The change replaces the audit event on document receipt with an operational log line. markDocumentReceived still saves case state under EDIT_CASE, but it no longer records an audit event with actor, action, target, and time, so AUD-1 is violated. The new log line does not contain an NPI value, and the ticket, independent approval, and CI run on the head commit meet the change-process rules. No exception covers the dropped audit. The change is rejected.
